query: '
SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    p.paciente_key,
    dep.departamento_key,

    CASE
        WHEN d.diagnosis_id IS NULL
            THEN sd.diagnostico_key
        ELSE gd.diagnostico_key
    END AS diagnostico_key,

    fi.fecha_key AS fecha_ingreso_key,
    fa.fecha_key AS fecha_alta_key,

    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,

    DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        a.admission_date,
        a.discharge_date
    ) AS dias_estancia,

    CAST(1 AS INT) AS conteo_admisiones

FROM silver.admissions a

INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id_bk

INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep
    ON a.department = dep.nombre_departamento

INNER JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi
    ON a.admission_date = fi.fecha_completa

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa
    ON a.discharge_date = fa.fecha_completa

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        diagnosis_id,
        admission_id,
        icd_code,
        diagnosis_description,
        severity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY admission_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM silver.diagnoses
) d
    ON a.admission_id = d.admission_id
    AND d.rn = 1

LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico gd
    ON gd.codigo_icd = LTRIM(RTRIM(d.icd_code))
    AND (
        gd.descripcion_patologia = d.diagnosis_description
        OR (
            gd.descripcion_patologia IS NULL
            AND d.diagnosis_description IS NULL
        )
    )
    AND gd.nivel_severidad =
        ISNULL(d.severity, 'No especificado')

CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT diagnostico_key
    FROM gold.dim_diagnostico
    WHERE codigo_icd = 'SIN-DIAG'
) sd
',
